title: Hello Cube
description: A lit, spinning cube — the smallest complete 3D scene.

title: Bouncing Sprites
description: Eight textured quads bouncing inside a 640x480 virtual frame.

title: Light Show
description: Four colored point lights orbiting a Phong sphere in real time.

title: CRT Bloom
description: A declarative post-effect chain: bloom plus a color filter.

title: Input Playground
description: An interactive tour of the F9 input API: mouse move/down/wheel callbacks paint a particle trail, keyboard events and held-state queries steer it, and surface-pixel pointer coordinates are mapped into the 2D frame. Self-plays until you interact.

title: Gamepad Tester
description: An interactive tour of the F13 gamepad API: plug in a controller and watch every semantic button, stick, trigger, and d-pad element light up live, with pad name, mapping status, and connect/disconnect events. Unmapped pads fall back to a raw axes/buttons panel. Keys 1-4 select a slot, Tab cycles.

title: Audio Showcase
description: An interactive tour of the F14 audio API: a looping streamed track plus a 32-voice effect bank. Click a pad (or press 1/2/3) to fire a blip/chime/thud with pan from the click x and pitch from the click y, Space pauses/resumes the music, M mutes, and [ / ] change volume. On the web, audio unlocks on the first input.

title: Texture Showcase
description: A real CC0 paving-stone texture (ambientCG) loaded from the sample's asset pack: shown full and cropped with sourceRect, and tiled across a 3D ground plane and spinning cube.

title: glTF Model
description: A real CC0 glTF model (Avocado by Microsoft, Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets) imported with loadMeshData, base-color mapped and lit under the engine's Phong model.

title: Fox Walk
description: A real CC0 rigged model (Fox, Quaternius' Ultimate Animated Animals) imported with loadMeshData and CPU-posed with mesh.pose from a script-owned clock, drawn with skinned: true.

title: Script Modules
description: A lit 3D scene split across files with the F10 CommonJS module system: synchronous require loads a relative module (palette.js), an extension-less specifier with the deterministic .js fallback (orbit), and a JSON module (data/scene.json) from the sample's asset pack, then registers update/render hooks from the composed data.

title: Text Showcase
description: A TrueType font baked into a fixed atlas with the F8a text API: loadFontData -> createFont (with baked outline/shadow) draws a title, a wrapped paragraph whose alignment cycles through left/center/right/justify (Tab), and a live typing area (type, Enter, Backspace). The font is a CC0 Kenney font from the sample's asset pack.

title: Particle Showcase
description: The F11 particle system: an additive fire (view billboards, continuous emission), an alpha smoke plume, a y-axis-billboard ember burst (emit), lifetime-interpolated size/color, plus a 2D drawSprites row. All procedural textures, no asset pack.

title: Water Plane
description: F11 oriented-plane particles: a water surface built from fixed `facing: 'plane'` quads (normal +Y) that stay world-aligned as the camera orbits, with a camera-facing spray and a y-billboard above it.

title: Physics Playground
description: F12 collision + character + dynamics: a capsule character walks a static course with moveAndSlide (floor/wall classification, a ramp, and a step), triggers a sensor volume, pushes falling and pushable crates, and casts a raycast for line of sight. Procedural geometry, no asset pack.

title: Skybox
description: A period sky dome: an inverted sphere with an unlit, diffuse-mapped material drawn camera-locked and first with depthWrite:false, so a real CC0 equirectangular sky (Poly Haven) fills the background and never occludes the lit scene as the camera orbits.

title: Blob Shadow
description: A flat blob shadow under a moving character, drawn as a ground-plane billboard (facing:'plane') with alpha blending and a small lift, using a radial texture generated at runtime with createImageData. The camera orbits to show the shadow stays flat on the ground.

title: Neon Pong
description: Rung 1 of the game gallery series: a complete Pong match — serve, rally, score to 7, restart — built from 2D quads, text, and keyboard/mouse input only. An imperfect AI opposes the player, P toggles two-player, and it self-plays until the first input.

title: Bloom Breakout
description: Rung 2 of the game gallery series: a complete Breakout — paddle, ball, three brick layouts, three lives, score to win — with additive particle shatter, a bloom + color-filter post chain, screen shake, and one-shot synthesized SFX. It self-plays until the first input.

title: Glow Gauntlet
description: Rung 3 of the game gallery series: a one-button copter dodger. Hold to rise, release to sink, and thread scrolling gates on keyboard, mouse, or gamepad. Score ramps speed and tightens gaps, death bursts into particles with a sting, and a synthesized music loop streams underneath. It self-plays until the first input.
